verdict.rationale: Extend publishes a structured API reference with per-endpoint pages (authentication, file upload) and an API Quickstart. Test API keys let developers run requests safely. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console, or that it ships runnable example snippets. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API playground/try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
